title: 8-round AES-192: Key-bridge improvement of the herd attack

display.name: Key-bridge improvement of the herd attack

target.description: Reduced 8-round AES-192 with whitening k_-1, final MixColumns omitted, and u_i=MC^-1(k_i).

setting.key_relation: One fixed standard AES schedule; no related-key oracle.
setting.key_population: General fixed key; no weak-key subset is specified.
setting.plaintext_model: Near-codebook chosen plaintexts of the FKL herd construction; original protocol reviewed separately.
assumptions: Section5.2.1 reduces ten dominant partial-sum peaks to three; it does not obtain the full factor256 key-guess reduction.
The source gives an approximate running-time improvement; complete operation-by-operation calibration remains open.

time.note: Journal Section5.2.1 author estimate: about3-fold improvement over2^188.

data.note: No new data figure in Section5.2.1. Original FKL near-codebook CP endpoint remains separately sourced.

memory.note: No separate resource budget for this scope.

success.description: The journal does not quantify overall recovery success for this exact endpoint.
